modificationStatement: Modified: the Open English WordNet 2024 release was filtered and reformatted for offline lookup. At most four senses are kept per headword, at most one example and five synonyms per sense, and the data was converted into a JSONL payload with a binary index. Semantic relations, sense keys, verb frames and sense counts were discarded. No definition text was altered.
